model.name: MiniMax H3 P-H3-Image 20B
model.description: Generates a single image from text, or edits an image with up to 8 input images, in 8 steps without guidance, or in 2 to 4 steps with the pDMD accelerator profiles. Works best at 8 megapixels, and is strongest at photorealism, film and editorial looks and graphic styles with short quoted text. No video or audio; hands and dense text can break.

prompt: A photograph by an experienced documentary photographer of an old fishmonger in a Lisbon market, seen from counter height as she wraps a sardine in brown paper. Crates of ice stand behind her and a single hanging bulb lights her hands from the left, leaving the aisle behind in soft shadow. A hand-painted sign above her reads "PEIXE FRESCO", no other text.
